'''Tomin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] in the [[Chibias/Legends|Chibias]] [[Chibias concert hall|concert hall]].

==Biography==
Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Tomin and [[Jayx]], a fellow security officer, arrested [[Zakarisz Ghent]] in the Chibias concert hall. The two were following the orders of Counselor [[Markko|Raines]].<ref name="Handoff" />

They were attacked by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] when she rescued the young [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]].<ref name="Handoff" />
